title: Post-cutover production verification before ACTIVE
productionChange: DeploymentActivationService.activate() now calls router.health(cutoverTarget) after cutover and only advances to ACTIVE when the verdict is HEALTHY. Non-HEALTHY verdicts transition to ACTIVATION_FAILED with POST_CUTOVER_HEALTH_<verdict>:<reason>. Evidence is written to reconciliation_evidence on both POST_ACTIVATION_HEALTH_CHECK and ACTIVE transitions.
invariants: ACTIVE requires provider-verified HEALTHY health on the exact cutover target
ACTIVE is not written merely because cutover returned ok
Lease/fenced CAS still gate every transition
Cutover refusal does not call health
Evidence persisted on existing intent columns only
